new_state.lifecycle: post-roadmap DEVELOPMENT activity (not a numbered phase; no Phase 8)

po_authorization_ref: Product-Owner direction of 2026-08-17: clean IAM-v2 replacement. Complete the missing runtime wiring and make IAM-v2 the sole IAM authority on the DEVELOPMENT appliance.

wiring_implemented.finding: The Postgres repositories the wiring needed ALREADY EXISTED and were simply never constructed: iamv2.PgRepository (repo_pg.go), iamv2.PgCommerceRepository (commerce_repo_pg.go) and iamv2.PgCommerceAdminRepository (commerce_admin_repo_pg.go). The blocker was three unwritten constructor calls, not a missing domain.
wiring_implemented.scd: data-plane/cmd/scd/authsec.go builds PgRepository and PgCommerceRepository from the pool it already holds when the respective master flag is ON, replacing the two errors that refused to start.
wiring_implemented.edged: data-plane/cmd/edged/main.go builds PgCommerceAdminRepository under the same condition.
wiring_implemented.no_silent_fallback: Nil-while-dark is unchanged: with a master flag OFF the component is constructed with NO repository and short-circuits to disabled, so an enabled IAM-v2 can never quietly serve from legacy tables.
wiring_implemented.tests: go build ./... and go vet clean; internal/iamv2, cmd/scd and cmd/edged package tests all pass.

next: Deploy the wired build to the DEVELOPMENT appliance, enable IAM-v2 as the sole IAM authority there, and verify it end to end on the running services.
